templates.name: main
templates.body: if Module.instances.isEmpty() then "// <no Module instance in the model>" else verilogModule(Module.instances.first(), "verilog")

templates.name: sp
templates.body:
if L == "smv" then (if k == "neg" then "!" else if k == "conj" then " & " else if k == "disj" then " | " else if k == "eq" then " = " else if k == "tru" then "TRUE" else if k == "fls" then "FALSE" else "<no spelling " + k + ">")
else (if k == "neg" then "~" else if k == "conj" then " & " else if k == "disj" then " | " else if k == "eq" then " == " else if k == "tru" then "1'b1" else if k == "fls" then "1'b0" else "<no spelling " + k + ">")

templates.name: expr
nary
templates.body: if ops == null or ops.isEmpty() then empty else "(" + ops.map(o => expr(o, L)).join(sep) + ")"

templates.name: impl
templates.body:
if L == "smv" then "(" + expr(e.left, L) + " -> " + expr(e.right, L) + ")"
else "(" + sp("neg", L) + "(" + expr(e.left, L) + ") | " + expr(e.right, L) + ")"

templates.name: temporal
templates.body:
if L == "smv" then "(" + op + " " + expr(e.op, L) + ")"
else "<temporal operator " + op + " has no Verilog form>"

templates.name: constLit
vPorts
templates.body:
"input  wire clk,
  input  wire rst" +
(if m.inputs.isEmpty() then "" else ",
  " + m.inputs.map(p => "input  wire " + vRange(p.width) + p.name).join(",
  ")) +
(if m.outputs.isEmpty() then "" else ",
  " + m.outputs.map(p => "output wire " + vRange(p.width) + p.name).join(",
  "))

templates.name: verilogModule
